original_request: Create a local work-report skill that produces reviewable Markdown reports, with deterministic checks and a separate Judge review step. Keep it local Markdown only: no database, no network publishing, and no scheduler.
workspace_policy: Fixtures are anonymized examples for independent review. Test-only answer keys are separated from report bodies and source notes.
evidence_files: evidence.txt is created dynamically by tests beside generated report.md when needed
